name: Argentine Film Festival Supported by The Miracle Theater Foundation
description: Sunday 25th 4pm PEPITA, LA PISTOLERA Argentina. 103m. Dir. Lucia Puenzo. Set in Mar del Plata during the winter of 1985. It follows the life of Margarita Di Tullio, a sex worker and expectant mother who confronts exploitation rings, local mafias, and corrupt police. The plot takes on historical significance when she defends herself and kills three criminals who break into her home a real-life event that turns her into one of the most famous and controversial figures in the Argentine underworld. Sunday 25th 7pm LO DEJAMOS ACA Argentina. 98m. Dir. Hernan Goldfrid. A pragmatic psychoanalyst, disillusioned with traditional methods, begins to cross ethical boundaries with his patients until he takes on a new patient: a writer suffering from writer's block and alcohol problems.
